name: Barbarian audit: Smasher spell modifier reaches its target spells (#1032)
contract: Audit report #1032 asked for a script for a passive whose effects are native spell-mod auras (107 flat, 108 percent). The effect BasePoints and EffectSpellClassMask in Spell.dbc name the spell-mod operation, amount and affected Barbarian spells; Player::ApplySpellMod, which the spell_modifier metric calls, must deliver base+flat or base*(100+pct)/100. Expected values are computed from the DBC amount, not from the implementation.

steps.label: before: 560532 has no modifier for op 14
561394 op 14 percent -100 reaches 560532 (mask selects 1 Barbarian spell(s))
